title: MSA APX-MSA-2024-0117 — Rheinchem Pharma Services GmbH
content:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Contract No. APX-MSA-2024-0117
Between Apex Conglomerate (acting for ApexPharm) and Rheinchem Pharma Services GmbH ("Supplier")
Signed on 2024-11-04

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Key Performance Indicators" means the measurable service levels set out in Schedule 2.
1.2 "Quality Agreement" means the separate agreement defining the GMP responsibilities of each party.
1.3 "Services" means the services described in the applicable Statement of Work.
1.4 "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party.
1.5 "Deliverables" means all goods, materials, reports and results provided by the Supplier under this Agreement or any Statement of Work.
1.6 "Control" means the ownership of more than 50% of the voting rights or the power to direct the management of an entity.
1.7 "Personal Data" means personal data as defined in Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).
1.8 "Term" means the period described in the clause headed Term and Termination.
1.9 "Statement of Work" means a document agreed in writing describing specific Services, Deliverables, timelines and fees.

2. SCOPE OF SERVICES
This Agreement governs the supply of Services and Deliverables by Rheinchem Pharma Services GmbH to Apex Conglomerate and its Affiliates. The Supplier shall perform the Services with the skill, care and diligence expected of a leading provider in the pharmaceutical industry. Any change to the scope of the Services shall be agreed through the change control procedure described in Schedule 4. This Agreement governs the supply of Services and Deliverables by Rheinchem Pharma Services GmbH to Apex Conglomerate and its Affiliates. The Supplier shall perform the Services with the skill, care and diligence expected of a leading provider in the pharmaceutical industry. Any change to the scope of the Services shall be agreed through the change control procedure described in Schedule 4. This Agreement governs the supply of Services and Deliverables by Rheinchem Pharma Services GmbH to Apex Conglomerate and its Affiliates. The Supplier shall perform the Services with the skill, care and diligence expected of a leading provider in the pharmaceutical industry. Any change to the scope of the Services shall be agreed through the change control procedure described in Schedule 4.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT
Fees are set out in Schedule 3 and are fixed for the first twelve months. Invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt. Price adjustments after the first contract year shall not exceed the Eurostat HICP index for the euro area plus 0.5 percentage points. Late payment interest shall accrue at the statutory rate. The Supplier shall provide a monthly consumption report itemising volumes, unit prices and credits. Disputed invoice items shall be notified within 20 Business Days and the undisputed portion shall be paid when due. Fees are set out in Schedule 3 and are fixed for the first twelve months. Invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt. Price adjustments after the first contract year shall not exceed the Eurostat HICP index for the euro area plus 0.5 percentage points. Late payment interest shall accrue at the statutory rate. The Supplier shall provide a monthly consumption report itemising volumes, unit prices and credits. Disputed invoice items shall be notified within 20 Business Days and the undisputed portion shall be paid when due. 

4. SERVICE LEVELS
On-time delivery: target 98.5% of orders per calendar month.
Deviation notification: target within 24 hours of detection.
Certificate of Analysis turnaround: target 5 Business Days.
Change notification: target 90 days before implementation.
Temperature excursion reporting: target within 2 hours.
Batch documentation completeness: target 100%.

Persistent failure (three or more KPIs missed in any quarter) constitutes a material breach. 

5. QUALITY AND GMP
The parties shall comply with the Quality Agreement, which prevails over this Agreement in respect of GMP matters. The Supplier shall maintain a pharmaceutical quality system, notify ApexPharm of any regulatory inspection within 2 Business Days, and shall not change materials, processes, equipment or manufacturing sites without prior written approval. Batch records shall be retained for at least one year after the expiry date of the batch and in any case not less than five years. Batch records shall be retained for at least one year after the expiry date of the batch and in any case not less than five years. The parties shall comply with the Quality Agreement, which prevails over this Agreement in respect of GMP matters. The Supplier shall maintain a pharmaceutical quality system, notify ApexPharm of any regulatory inspection within 2 Business Days, and shall not change materials, processes, equipment or manufacturing sites without prior written approval. Batch records shall be retained for at least one year after the expiry date of the batch and in any case not less than five years. 

6. CONFIDENTIALITY
Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to employees and advisers who need to know it and are bound by equivalent obligations. These obligations survive termination for 5 years. Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to employees and advisers who need to know it and are bound by equivalent obligations. These obligations survive termination for 5 years. Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to employees and advisers who need to know it and are bound by equivalent obligations. These obligations survive termination for 5 years. 

7. DATA PROTECTION
Where the Supplier processes Personal Data on behalf of Apex, the parties shall enter into a data processing agreement compliant with Article 28 GDPR. The Supplier shall not transfer Personal Data outside the European Economic Area without prior written consent and appropriate safeguards. Personal data breaches shall be notified to Apex without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours. Where the Supplier processes Personal Data on behalf of Apex, the parties shall enter into a data processing agreement compliant with Article 28 GDPR. The Supplier shall not transfer Personal Data outside the European Economic Area without prior written consent and appropriate safeguards. Personal data breaches shall be notified to Apex without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours. 

9. AUDIT AND INSPECTION
9.1 Apex, its auditors and regulators may audit the Supplier's facilities, records and systems relevant to the Services upon 30 Business Days' notice, and without notice in case of a suspected critical quality or compliance issue.
9.2 The Supplier shall ensure equivalent audit rights towards its subcontractors.
9.3 The Supplier shall remedy audit findings in accordance with an agreed corrective action plan.

10. LIABILITY AND INSURANCE
Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed 200% of the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim. This limitation shall not apply to breaches of confidentiality, data protection obligations, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, or liability for death or personal injury. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss. The Supplier shall maintain product liability insurance of at least EUR 10 million per occurrence. Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed 200% of the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim. This limitation shall not apply to breaches of confidentiality, data protection obligations, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, or liability for death or personal injury. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss. The Supplier shall maintain product liability insurance of at least EUR 10 million per occurrence. 

11. FORCE MAJEURE
Neither party shall be liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided it notifies the other party promptly and uses reasonable efforts to mitigate. If a force majeure event continues for more than 90 days, either party may terminate the affected Statement of Work by written notice. Supply shortages of the Supplier's own vendors do not constitute force majeure unless caused by a force majeure event. 

12. ASSIGNMENT
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, not to be unreasonably withheld, except to an Affiliate.

14. CHANGE OF CONTROL
14.1 The Supplier shall notify Apex in writing of any Change of Control within 30 days of its occurrence.
14.2 "Change of Control" means any event by which a person or group of persons acting in concert acquires Control of the Supplier or of any entity that Controls the Supplier.
14.3 Following a Change of Control, Apex may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, by giving not less than 60 days' written notice, provided such notice is given within 12 months of Apex becoming aware of the Change of Control. No termination fee shall be payable.
14.4 During the notice period the Supplier shall continue to perform the Services and shall cooperate in the orderly transfer of the Services to Apex or a replacement supplier.

15. TERM AND TERMINATION
15.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of 5 years, renewing automatically for successive periods of 12 months unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 6 months before the end of the then-current term.
15.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within 30 days of written notice.
15.3 Apex may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 120 days' written notice.


16. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Switzerland. The courts of Zurich have exclusive jurisdiction, without prejudice to interim relief.

MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Contract No. APX-MSA-2023-0089
Between Apex Conglomerate (acting for ApexPharm) and Lumen Analytics Lab Kft. ("Supplier")
Signed on 2023-09-19

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Quality Agreement" means the separate agreement defining the GMP responsibilities of each party.
1.2 "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party.
1.3 "Statement of Work" means a document agreed in writing describing specific Services, Deliverables, timelines and fees.
1.4 "Term" means the period described in the clause headed Term and Termination.
1.5 "Good Manufacturing Practice" means the principles and guidelines laid down in EU Directive 2003/94/EC and EudraLex Volume 4, as amended.
1.6 "Control" means the ownership of more than 50% of the voting rights or the power to direct the management of an entity.
1.7 "Personal Data" means personal data as defined in Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).
1.8 "Services" means the services described in the applicable Statement of Work.
1.9 "Key Performance Indicators" means the measurable service levels set out in Schedule 2.

2. SCOPE OF SERVICES
This Agreement governs the supply of Services and Deliverables by Lumen Analytics Lab Kft. to Apex Conglomerate and its Affiliates. Services shall be performed by appropriately qualified and trained personnel, whose qualification records shall be made available upon request. No Statement of Work shall take effect until signed by authorised representatives of both parties. 6. CONFIDENTIALITY

9. AUDIT AND INSPECTION
9.1 Apex, its auditors and regulators may audit the Supplier's facilities, records and systems relevant to the Services upon 10 Business Days' notice, and without notice in case of a suspected critical quality or compliance issue.
9.2 The Supplier shall ensure equivalent audit rights towards its subcontractors.
9.3 The Supplier shall remedy audit findings in accordance with an agreed corrective action plan.

10. LIABILITY AND INSURANCE
Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed 100% of the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim. This limitation shall not apply to breaches of confidentiality, data protection obligations, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, or liability for death or personal injury. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss. The Supplier shall maintain product liability insurance of at least EUR 10 million per occurrence. Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed 100% of the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim. This limitation shall not apply to breaches of confidentiality, data protection obligations, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, or liability for death or personal injury. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss. The Supplier shall maintain product liability insurance of at least EUR 10 million per occurrence. 

11. FORCE MAJEURE
Neither party shall be liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided it notifies the other party promptly and uses reasonable efforts to mitigate. If a force majeure event continues for more than 90 days, either party may terminate the affected Statement of Work by written notice. Supply shortages of the Supplier's own vendors do not constitute force majeure unless caused by a force majeure event. 

12. ASSIGNMENT AND CHANGE OF CONTROL
12.1 Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
12.6 Any Change of Control of the Supplier requires the prior written consent of Apex. If the Supplier undergoes a Change of Control without such consent, Apex may terminate this Agreement and any Statement of Work with immediate effect by written notice.

15. TERM AND TERMINATION
15.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of 5 years, renewing automatically for successive periods of 12 months unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 6 months before the end of the then-current term.
15.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach not remedied within 30 days of written notice.
15.3 Apex may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 120 days' written notice.


16. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Ireland. The courts of Frankfurt am Main have exclusive jurisdiction, without prejudice to interim relief.
